headline.family_guess: Inter/Helvetica-Neue Bold (generic sans, YouTube-native burned caption font)
headline.size_rel: ~0.09 of frame height, 1-3 words per card

caption.family_guess: same as headline, one word/short-phrase captions, word-by-word reveal

layout.host_pos: center-frame, chest-up, alternates between facing-camera talking and 3/4 profile pacing shots — profile shots signal 'thinking/building tension', frontal shots signal 'direct address/punchline'
layout.safe_zones: captions sit in lower-third (~78-88% frame height); screenshot/tweet cards inset upper-half or center, never overlapping mouth
layout.caption_pos: bottom-third, centered horizontally, single line, 1-3 words per beat, changes every ~1s (word-paced to speech)

transitions: none — single continuous handheld/tripod talking-head take for 56s, no hard cuts visible in sampled frames; only overlay cards pop in/out and host pivots between camera-facing and profile stance

themeable: caption_fill/accent color (currently yellow, swappable per channel brand)
tweet/screenshot card content (screenshotted proof, fully replaceable per topic)
host wardrobe color (black polo, could reskin)
background (plain office wall, low-cost, easily replicated)
